remarks: Experience elevated urban living at Eastside Commons! This spacious 1-bedroom, 1-bath, 860 sq. ft. residence combines contemporary comfort, exceptional amenities, and an unbeatable Stamford location. Freshly painted with brand-new carpeting, this open-concept home features granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, and an island/breakfast bar that flows seamlessly into the bright, spacious living area. Sliding doors lead to an oversized private corner balcony overlooking the beautifully landscaped courtyard. The generously sized bedroom features a large walk-in closet and ensuite bath with double vanities. Additional comforts include central A/C, gas heat and cooking, in-unit washer and dryer, ample storage, one reserved space in the secure underground garage INCLUDED in the rent, plus one floating visitor space. Enjoy resort-style amenities including a fully equipped fitness center, dry-cleaning drop-off service, visitor parking, and a charming cottage-style courtyard with grills and seating. Perfectly located in the heart of Mid-City Stamford, with downtown restaurants, shopping, the Ferguson Library, Stamford Palace Theatre, parks, and minutes from Stamford's three beautiful beaches. A commuter's dream with a shuttle running to Metro-North, and a 1 minute drive to I-95. This is Metropolitan living at it's finest!
